d:
[Branded Content] The Ultraviolette X-47 takes a different approach to electric motorcycles. Instead of feeling like an electric vehicle first, it aims to retain the character and involvement of a motorcycle — while bringing instant electric performance into the mix.
In this feature, we take the X-47 out on the road and into mixed riding conditions to see what it is like as an electric ADV.
Three ride modes: Glide, Combat and Ballistic
Instant electric torque and strong acceleration
Regenerative braking for more control while riding hard
Adventure-focused riding across mixed conditions
